title: Hearty Bean Stew
description: A comforting, flavorful stew made with tender beans and a hint of Turkish spice.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the Turkish Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the stew beans, tomato paste, and vegetable broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the jubilant beans and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
